notes.title: Zen & Japanese Update
notes.notes:
🌸 New Features

Japanese Localization Support
The game is now fully available in Japanese!
New Zen Garden inspired Theme

✨ Polish & Improvements
General Refinements

Various small tweaks and quality-of-life improvements throughout the game
Smoother overall experience with improved stability

🔮 What's Next?

More themes and customization options are always in the works, as well as a bigger update with a new system/feature entirely. The localization system opens up possibilities for reaching more players worldwide!

notes.title: Hexcavator Update 1 - Comfy Controls
notes.notes:
Small update with a large number of great changes!

🎥 More intuitive Camera controls! Camera controls have been massively improved! Use Q and E to smoothly rotate around, and WASD to pan around for easy viewing.

⏰ Timer? Or no Timer? Some love the challenge of beating times, others just want to relax and dig. You can now toggle the timer off completely in the options menu! When it's hidden, your flag and tile counters scoot over to fill the space perfectly.

🚩 Flags That Actually Stand Out A small but meaningful change. Flagged tiles now have a subtle darkening effect so you can easily spot your marked mines.

⚡ Chording! Left+right click on any numbered tile when you've flagged the right amount of mines around it.

📖 Better Tutorial I improved the tutorial/controls screen to make it higher quality and match the rest of the game!

🖥️[More Resolutions/b] I added in more resolution options to try to help support a wider range of players!
